metadata.Name: mtrl-gpt-oss-20b-lora
metadata.DisplayName: Agentic RFT for GPT OSS 20B Lora
metadata.Description: Agentic RFT training recipe for gpt-oss-20b

adam_beta1.description: Exponential decay rate for the running average of the gradient (first moment) in Adam.
adam_beta1.hint: Must be a value between 0.0 and 0.999999

adam_beta2.description: Exponential decay rate for the running average of the squared gradient (second moment) in Adam.
adam_beta2.hint: Must be a value between 0.0 and 0.999999

adam_eps.description: Small constant added to the denominator for numerical stability in Adam's update rule.

advantage_method.description: Method for computing advantages for rollouts.

clip_high_threshold.description: Upper bound for clipping the policy probability ratio in the loss.

clip_low_threshold.description: Lower bound for clipping the policy probability ratio π_new/π_old in the PPO-style surrogate loss.

global_batch_size.description: Total number of training samples processed per optimizer step. Larger values improve training stability but use more memory.
global_batch_size.hint: Choose from the available batch size options

group_size.description: Rollouts per prompt used to compute group-based advantages (GRPO / RLOO).
group_size.hint: Must be a value between 2 and 32

learning_rate.description: Step size for weight updates during optimization. Controls how much model weights change per gradient step. Set lower for RL (e.g., 1e-5) to avoid policy collapse; higher for SFT/DPO (e.g., 1e-4).
learning_rate.hint: Must be a value between 0 and 0.01

lora_alpha.description: LoRA scaling factor. The effective learning rate for LoRA adapters scales as alpha/rank. Typically set to 2x the LoRA rank.

lora_rank.description: Number of trainable dimensions in the LoRA adapter. Higher values increase model capacity but use more memory.

max_epochs.description: Number of complete passes through the entire training dataset. More epochs allow the model to learn patterns more thoroughly but increase training time and risk of overfitting.
max_epochs.hint: Must be a value between 1 and 30

max_steps.description: Maximum number of optimizer steps. When set, training stops after this many steps regardless of epochs remaining.
max_steps.hint: Must be a value between 1 and 1000

max_steps_off_policy.description: Staleness threshold in asynchronous training. When 0, it is synchronous training.

model_name_or_path.description: Model identifier or path to pretrained model

name.hint: A training job with the name {name} will be created

output_path.description: Local output path for model artifacts

pass_k_values.description: List of k values for computing pass@k metrics.

rollout_max_concurrency.description: The max in-flight rollout processes can happen in parallel.

rollout_max_retries.description: Number of retry attempts for failed rollouts.

rollout_timeout.description: Failure handling: time after which we treat as the rollout failure.

sampling_max_tokens.description: Max tokens the model can generate per turn during rollout.

sampling_top_p.description: Nucleus-sampling cutoff. Samples only from the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability ≥ top_p.

success_threshold.description: Reward threshold for counting a rollout as 'successful'.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for evaluation and generation. Higher values increase output randomness/diversity; lower values make outputs more deterministic.
temperature.hint: Must be a value between 0.0 and 2.0

training_recipe.yaml:
async_config:
  max_steps_off_policy: '{{max_steps_off_policy}}'
batch:
  group_size: '{{group_size}}'
  training_batch_size: '{{global_batch_size}}'
  val_batch_size: null
  val_group_size: 1
  val_random_sample: false
display_name: Agentic RFT for GPT OSS 20B Lora
eval_sampling_params:
  max_tokens: 4096
  temperature: 0.0
  top_p: 1.0
model:
  adam_beta1: '{{adam_beta1}}'
  adam_beta2: '{{adam_beta2}}'
  adam_eps: '{{adam_eps}}'
  grad_clip_norm: '{{adam_grad_clip_norm}}'
  learning_rate: '{{learning_rate}}'
  lora_alpha: '{{lora_alpha}}'
  lora_rank: '{{lora_rank}}'
  max_sequence_length: 65536
  model_name: '{{model_name_or_path}}'
  weight_decay: '{{adam_weight_decay}}'
recipe_version: 1.0.26
rl:
  advantage_method: '{{advantage_method}}'
  advantage_normalization: true
  clip_high_threshold: '{{clip_high_threshold}}'
  clip_low_threshold: '{{clip_low_threshold}}'
  gamma: 1.0
  loss_fn: '{{loss_fn}}'
rollout:
  max_concurrency: '{{rollout_max_concurrency}}'
  max_retries: '{{rollout_max_retries}}'
  rollout_tps: 5
  timeout: '{{rollout_timeout}}'
run:
  model_type: mtrl
  name: '{{name}}'
sampling_params:
  max_tokens: '{{sampling_max_tokens}}'
  temperature: '{{temperature}}'
  top_p: '{{sampling_top_p}}'
schedule:
  epochs: '{{max_epochs}}'
  max_steps: '{{max_steps}}'
  save_every: 1
  val_at_start: true
  val_every: '{{val_every}}'
val_metrics_config:
  pass_k_values: '{{pass_k_values}}'
  success_threshold: '{{success_threshold}}'

recipes.display_name: Agentic RFT for GPT OSS 20B Lora
